tier2_explanatory.short_meaning: Home ruler; ruler of the enclosure
tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Germanic heim, 'home', + ric, 'ruler'. Its root is Germanic heim + ric. A common Christian name; borne by several kings and saints. Henry is a Germanic name meaning “Home ruler; ruler of the enclosure”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
